item.title: Crookston Disabled Veterans Auxiliary and Legion Auxiliary supply winter clothing to veteran families
item.description: The Crookston Disabled American Veterans’ Auxiliary Chapter 14 recently collaborated with the Crookston American Legion Auxiliary Unit 20 to supply winter clothing to veteran families at the Cathedral Elementary School.
